name: yx-architecture
description: Architecture canon for Flutter apps built on yx_scope, yx_state and yx_navigation: layer rules, Data-Domain boundaries, the ViewModel contract, embeddable feature-facade contracts, and three review and planning procedures. The API of each package is covered by the skill that ships inside that package.

interface.shortDescription: Architecture canon for Flutter apps built on the yx stack.
interface.longDescription: Layer rules, Data-Domain boundaries, ViewModel contracts and embeddable feature-facade contracts for applications built on yx_scope, yx_state and yx_navigation, plus commands to review code, plan a feature and design a feature facade.
